description: Deterministic release-gate contract for the PetTripFinder Greater Milwaukee market, derived from the committed authority at PTF-MILWAUKEE-PUBLICATION-042. Every number below is computed from this market's own state by release_contracts.derive_authority; none is inherited from the superseded 037 preparation, whose document remains refused by content hash.

deployment_authorization.means: A passing contract means this market's assembled package is STRUCTURALLY deployable: its authority files agree, its routes match its reviewed inventory, no held identity leaks and every gate holds. It is not a deployment authorization, and PTF-MILWAUKEE-PUBLICATION-042 deployed nothing.

provenance.held_note: Held rows reach no publication set. Hyatt Regency because a price is not permission; Knickerbocker and The Iron Horse because the identity gate declined their policy subpages and the founder would not bypass it by hand.

supersedes.note: structure borrowed, every value re-derived; the document itself remains refused by content hash

precursor.why: 042 stamps the publishing work order and both decision ledgers into the published document, which moves the package hash the contract pins. No approved record moved, and that is asserted separately.

identity_census.note: The 147-identity census was built by PTF-MILWAUKEE-MARKET-FACTORY-001 from five independent source families and reconciled over the full market by PTF-HYATT-BEST-WESTERN-PREMIUM-RESOLUTION-028. The census carries no policy annotation this contract relies on: every no-pets record here was adjudicated into the exclusion registry by an explicit founder decision, never read off a census field.

reconciliation.note: verified_no_pets counts ONLY VERIFIED_NO_PETS records this market owns in the generated exclusion registry. unresolved is UNKNOWN, never negative evidence: a failed capture answers nothing.

policy_package.note: The verified hotel identities are DERIVED from this package at assembly time via scripts.pettripfinder.site_data.verified_public_hotels(); they are not restated here. This market's package additionally carries published: true and a publication block naming the work order that flipped it -- publication is a state of the package, not a property of any record, and the records are byte-identical to the ones the founder approved.
policy_package.structured_pricing_note: Twenty of the seventy records price by stay length and carry fee_tiers rather than a single pet_fee: the ladder IS the price and no single amount is asserted for them. Three carry a fee_cap, which is a ceiling and never a price. A renderer that flattened either would publish a number the property never quoted.
policy_package.sha_note: The sha256 of the package in its PUBLISHED state, which is deterministic: publication adds published: true, a note and a publication block dated from the founder's decision rather than from the clock, so the file a rebuild produces is the file this hash covers. While the market is unpublished the committed package hashes differently, on purpose -- the contract describes the published market.

public_surface.held_hotel_exclusion: Every seed hotel this market owns that is absent from the committed package must have NO public route and NO reference on any surface: hotel profiles, the hotels listing page, nearby-lodging cards, the policy-comparison table, the sitemap, canonicals, internal links and /go/ interstitials. This market owns none -- its seed inventory was derived one row per approved record, so a held or refused property has no inventory row to leak -- and the gate is derived, so it starts enforcing the moment that changes.

routes.note: route_mode market_prefixed: this market's hub, corridor and policy-comparison pages live under /pet-friendly-hotels/milwaukee-wi/. Seven of its configured corridors reach their publication minimum and claim a route; the rest claim none.

publish.note: The publish root must contain ONLY the static website plus the two Netlify control files. Build-internal reports the generator emits (_build_report.json, _broken_link_report.json, _quality_report.json, bundle_manifest.json) are read for gating but are excluded from site/ and must never ship.

status_note: Live: this contract gates the assembly of a PUBLISHED market. It grants no deployment -- publication is a state of the source and deployment is a separate act nobody has performed.
